findings.claim: Report-all swallowed physical Meta events and current Meta state could suppress the release of a previously delivered key.
findings.evidence: Real Chromium produced no bytes for MetaLeft and only CSI 97u for KeyA down then Meta down then KeyA up at aecbd65. At cb2badc it produces the required Meta pair and the complete interleaved press/repeat/release sequence; Cmd+V delivers no V event.
findings.layer: DOM keyboard ownership and Kitty emission

exemptions.evidence: Public docs already promise negotiated Kitty keyboard behavior and describe the browser limitation on unavailable blur releases; the fix restores those semantics without adding API or workflow.
